arguments.value: This agreement lets website owners (affiliates) place tracked links and ads for software publishers’ products on their sites and earn commissions based on resulting sales. Affiliates must register, get approved by the publisher, use the proper tracking link, keep login details secure, and clearly identify the relationship on their site. element 5 handles ordering, payment processing, refunds, customer service, and commission calculation, while the publisher supplies the products and sets commission rates. Commissions are paid only for qualifying sales that are not canceled or refunded, usually monthly once they reach a minimum threshold, and element 5 also takes a service fee. The agreement gives limited, revocable use of promotional materials, can be changed by notice, may be ended by either party at any time, and is governed by German law with disputes handled in Cologne.
